# v0.1.2

A naming fix.

Home Assistant shows `manifest.json`'s name in the integration list, which is
where somebody decides what they are installing. `hacs.json` already marked
the integration as unofficial; the manifest did not. It now reads
**MENNEKES AMTRON (Unofficial)**, and `scripts/check_repo.py` fails the build
if the two names disagree or if the marker is dropped again.

The config entry title stays `MENNEKES AMTRON`. That title becomes the device
name, and Home Assistant prefixes the device name to every entity id, so the
marker belongs in the list rather than in
`sensor.mennekes_amtron_unofficial_voltage_l1`.

Nothing else changed. Existing entries and entity ids are unaffected.
